VH_F_Skin.glb.title: 3D Reference Organ for Skin, Female v1.2
VH_F_Skin.glb.description: This reference organ was created using data from the Visible Human Female, provided by the National Library of Medicine.The torso of the skin model was moved up from previous editions to incorporate the clavicles and other anatomy for the breast. It was also adjusted to add space for the triceps surae and the ankle bones for the eventual addition of the triceps surae muscles and landmark organs.
VH_F_Skin.glb.cite: Kristen Browne; Heidi Schlehlein 2022. 3D Reference Organ for Skin, Female v1.2. https://doi.org/10.48539/HBM254.DVTN.589. Accessed on May 06, 2022.

VH_F_Small_Intestine.glb.title: 3D Reference Organ for Small Intestine, Female v1.1
VH_F_Small_Intestine.glb.description: This reference organ was created using data from the Visible Human Female, provided by the National Library of Medicine. The small intestines have been updated to include a measurement system. A centerline was made in the center of the intestines, and markers placed along the centerline. The teal discs measure 5 cm along the intestines, the green dashes measure 1 cm. The yellow disc marks the jejunoileal junction. The VHF small intestine total length is 200 cm.
VH_F_Small_Intestine.glb.cite: Kristen Browne; Heidi Schlehlein 2022. 3D Reference Organ for Small Intestine, Female v1.1. https://doi.org/10.48539/HBM887.PSNL.257. Accessed on May 06, 2022.

Allen_F_Brain.glb.title: 3D Reference Organ for Brain, Female v1.2
Allen_F_Brain.glb.description: This reference organ was created using data from the "Allen Human Reference Atlas – 3D, 2020" representing one half of the human brain (Ding et al., 2016). The 141 anatomical structures were mirrored to arrive at a whole human brain (as intended) and resized to fit the Visible Human Male and Female bodies. Note that this organ is not licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). Instead, these terms of use apply: Allen Institute Terms of Use.
Allen_F_Brain.glb.cite: Kristen Browne; Heidi Schlehlein. 2022. 3D Reference Organ for Brain, Female v1.2. https://doi.org/10.48539/HBM883.TBLV.838. Accessed on May 6, 2022.
Allen_F_Brain.glb.why: Made from the Allen Human Reference Atlas, not from the Visible Human Female.
